title: build(deps): bump @supabase/supabase-js from 2.117.2 to 2.118.0
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. @supabase/supabase-js 2.117.2 -> 2.118.0 in packages/client, which moves the whole @supabase family in lockstep. One release, 2.118.0 (2026-10-15): postgrest typegen tweaks (computed fields left out of select('*'), no-argument rpc overload resolution -- types), storage content-encoding support for uploads, and an upstream CI advisory patch (next/sharp in their own CI, not shipped). No repository code adopts any new API. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001); the payload of that friction is the lockfile audit in behavior_change. The Dependabot commit also flipped `peer: true` on 16 entries with unchanged versions (npm-version tool churn); per main's convention since #432 (ec88eedd) that churn is dropped so the diff is the bump only.
behavior_change: No declared-dependency movement beyond the titled family and no runtime change on any path the app uses. Lockfile audited against merge base 2e2d635f by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full, not by reading the diff view. Entry count is 400 before and 400 after. Exactly six node_modules entries changed, the @supabase family moving 2.117.2 -> 2.118.0 in lockstep: auth-js, functions-js, postgrest-js, realtime-js, storage-js, supabase-js -- each changing only version, resolved and integrity, except supabase-js, whose `dependencies` map also changed; that map was checked key by key (the #296 hiding place): same key set, only the five sibling pins 2.117.2 -> 2.118.0. Zero added, zero removed, zero non-@supabase entries touched (after dropping Dependabot's 16 peer-flag-only entries, which changed no version). The root entry differs in one key, dependencies.@supabase/supabase-js ^2.117.2 -> ^2.118.0. Runtime: the sole client constructor, src/auth/supabase.ts, is reachable from src/main.ts, so the bump reaches users; but the app calls only auth APIs (getSession, onAuthStateChange, signInWithPassword, signUp, signOut, signInWithOAuth). 2.118.0's changes are in postgrest (types/select) and storage (uploads), neither of which the app calls -- grep of packages/client/src finds no supabase.from/.storage/.rpc/.functions/.channel use.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared range for @supabase/supabase-js from ^2.117.2 to ^2.118.0 -- one line. package-lock.json resolves the family: auth-js, functions-js, postgrest-js, realtime-js, storage-js and supabase-js 2.117.2 -> 2.118.0, plus supabase-js's own sibling pins. No movement outside the family; Dependabot's peer-flag churn on 16 unrelated entries was reverted to the merge-base values.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff; the prior family manifest (supabase-js-2.117.2-bump) would cover these two files, and borrowing it is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.
